content.comment_body: Announcement regarding the phase-out of the [product_name] [product_name] (article number: [article_no]). Currently, this information is only provided in German. As of October 1, 2021, the [product_name] will enter the passive phase and be listed for phase-out. The product will continue to be available, and new orders are possible until full discontinuation. Service and support offerings remain unchanged. Affected product: [product_name], order number: [article_no]. The announcement date for phase-out is October 1, 2021.

analysis.insight_summary: The announcement informs users about the upcoming phase-out of a specific [product_name], detailing ongoing delivery, order options, and support until full discontinuation. Providing early notice helps users plan for future requirements, although the absence of an English version may create obstacles for non-German speakers.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear and timely notifications about changes in product status, including information in multiple languages. Additionally, continued delivery and support should be assured throughout the transition period.
